# LoomReflection

Everything the loom holds about a topic, arranged so the agent can see the whole and synthesise it itself: foundations, what was woven across them, where threads pull against each other, what was let go, and how understanding has shifted.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `topic` | `string` | The topic reflected on, as given. |
| `warp` | [`LoomThread`](loom-thread.md)`[]` | The foundational (warp) threads about the topic. |
| `weft` | [`LoomThread`](loom-thread.md)`[]` | The other (weft) threads about the topic, grouped by kind, the most salient first. |
| `tensions` | [`LoomTensionView`](loom-tension-view.md)`[]` | Open tensions between the threads found. |
| `knots` | [`LoomThread`](loom-thread.md)`[]` | Cut threads (knots) about the topic: what was let go, and why. |
| `changed` | [`LoomThread`](loom-thread.md)`[]` | Threads that have been reframed — their seams trace how understanding moved. |
| `isEmpty` | `boolean` | True when the loom holds nothing about the topic. Set by Maitento. |
